facts.fact: Egypt's Law No. 15/2004, issued 21 April 2004 and in force the day after publication, gives electronic signatures and electronic writing the evidential effect of paper, requires a licence from ITIDA to issue digital certificates, and orders executive regulations within six months.
facts.system: Law No. 15/2004 on E-Signature and Establishment of ITIDA

systems.system: Law No. 15/2004 on E-Signature and ITIDA

note: The text orders executive regulations but does not state they were issued, and records no licence granted.
